name: 秒悟 Meoo
desc: Alibaba Cloud platform that builds apps from a sentence
desc_zh: 阿里云上把一句话变成应用的平台
solves: Hiring someone to build a small web app costs time and money; describe it in chat and deploy the finished thing yourself.
solves_zh: 找人或自己写代码做个小应用都费时间，现在用聊天描述需求就能拿到能用的成品。
best_for: You need a landing page, mini program or internal tool live today and cannot write the code.
best_for_zh: 今天就要上线一个落地页、小程序或内部小工具，而你不会写代码。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.aliyun.com/product/monthly/2026-oct (阿里云产品十月刊), https://www.aliy）。 Backfill: released 2026-04-14, eleven days before the 2026-05-07 window, and absent from the ledger. Found in the Alibaba Cloud October digest, which reports that Meoo powers the new 我的应用 feature inside the 千问 app. Milestones after launch: 秒悟团队版 (Meoo Team) announced at WAIC on 2026-07-18 (新华网) and Meoo 1.0 released at 云栖大会 on 2026-09-23. Product site meoo.com is separate from the Alibaba Cloud console page https://www.aliyun.com/product/meoo. No English product name is published on the official pages, so the Chinese name is kept in `name`. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.aliyun.com/product/news/28719
